REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54137  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, January 8, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  proposed Wireless Telecommunications Facility located at Marine Stadium and the

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54139  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54140  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive and Marine & Beach
  Maintenance / Marina Operations Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
